quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's view of the business environment (annual securities report): the semiconductor market continues to grow substantially on AI / data center investment, with demand expansion marked in logic and memory, while the recovery of PC and smartphone demand is limited; management says attention is needed to market-structure changes such as memory supply tightness and price volatility accompanying the concentration of demand on AI, expects medium- to long-term growth in semiconductor manufacturing equipment on AI and leading-edge process investment, and is continuing to invest in the Tokyo Technical Center for developing power semiconductor and next-generation device equipment and for strengthening production capacity. For machine tools it expects firm demand in North America and Asia supported by data center and semiconductor-related capex, and precision gear demand for industrial robots and automation equipment.

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Machine tools, fiscal year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): in Japan, orders rose on subsidy-supported replacement demand for small and mid-size surface grinders and on precision gears for robots, but sales fell after strong large surface grinder sales a year earlier; in the US, orders and sales rose on aerospace-led capex and tax incentives; in Europe both fell on weak manufacturing, mainly in Germany; in China, orders for large surface grinders for industrial machinery, molds and semiconductor equipment were strong and orders and sales rose.

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, semiconductor-related equipment (annual securities report): besides expanding the lineup of silicon wafer processing machines, Okamoto is developing grinders and polishers for package substrates widely used in generative devices (image processing) for data centers, which are expected to grow larger; segment R&D expense JPY 89 million.

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, fiscal year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): total R&D expense JPY 144 million with 150 research, development and technical staff (6.7% of employees). Semiconductor-related equipment: developing high-efficiency grinders and polishers dedicated to SiC for power semiconductors, LT (lithium tantalate) and LN (lithium niobate) bonded substrates for SAW filters, and GaN for high-output lighting and 5G base-station power supplies. Machine tools (R&D JPY 54 million): continuing development of a dedicated grinder for SiC ingots; completed development of a 1,000mm rotary-table version of the VRG vertical rotary grinder and a robot-loading automation version of the UGM64GC grinding center for hard-to-cut semiconductor materials; added surface grinders with 1,500mm and 2,000mm tables (PSG156CA-iQ, PSG157CA-iQ, PSG206CA-iQ, PSG207CA-iQ).
